info.title: eGov Inbox Service
info.description:
Aggregates workflow (ProcessInstance) data with the underlying module/business object and (in V2) with Elasticsearch-indexed data to serve unified 'inbox' listings (pending applications, tasks, etc.) to eGov DIGIT front-ends.

Authentication: this service does not use an `Authorization` HTTP header. Every request body embeds a `RequestInfo` object whose `authToken` field carries the Bearer JWT issued by egov-user's OAuth login (`POST /user/oauth/token` or `POST /user/_login`). The platform resolves the caller's identity/roles from `RequestInfo.authToken` (and the accompanying `RequestInfo.userInfo`), not from a separate header. Clients must obtain this token via egov-user before calling any endpoint below.

post.description: Fetches the list of workflow ProcessInstances matching the given search/jurisdiction/module criteria, joins each with its corresponding business object (from the owning module service) and workflow state, and returns a paginated inbox listing. Backed by InboxService.fetchInboxData.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request envelope metadata. Carries the caller's identity via authToken - there is no separate Authorization header.

ts.description: Epoch millis at which the request was created

authToken.description: Bearer JWT access token obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (POST /user/oauth/token or POST /user/_login). This field is the authentication carrier for every API in this service - it is validated in lieu of an Authorization header.

UserInfo.description: Authenticated user detail echoed in RequestInfo, resolved server-side from authToken.

ResponseInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT response envelope metadata.

Error.description: Error object returned as part of the response body whenever ResponseInfo.status is 'failed'.

code.description: Module specific error code. Real values used by this service are defined in org.egov.inbox.util.ErrorConstants (e.g. PARSING_ERROR, MODULE_SEARCH_INVLAID, INVALID_MODULE_SEARCH_PATH, INVALID_MODULE, INVALID_MODULE_DATA, INVALID_OPERATOR_DATA).

message.description: English locale message of the error code.
message.example: Bussiness Service is mandatory for module search

description.description: Optional long description of the error to help clients take remedial action.
description.example: processSearchCriteria.businessService must be provided for a module level search

params.description: Replaceable fields referenced by the message (e.g. $1, $2).

ErrorRes.description: Standard error envelope returned by every endpoint in this service whenever request processing fails.

AuditDetails.description: Collection of audit related fields used by most models.

Document.description: Document attached during a workflow transition.

WorkflowUser.description: Minimal user reference used inside workflow ProcessInstance (org.egov.common.contract.request.User) - the assigner/assignee/assignes of a workflow step.

Action.description: A workflow transition option from the current state.

State.description: Current workflow state of a ProcessInstance.

ProcessInstance.description: A single workflow instance/step for a business object, as returned by egov-workflow-v2.

ProcessInstanceSearchCriteria.description: Criteria used to search workflow ProcessInstances.

InboxSearchCriteria.description: Top-level inbox search criteria combining workflow, module and jurisdiction filters (V1).

moduleSearchCriteria.description: Free-form criteria passed through to the owning module's search API

Inbox.description: A single inbox result item joining the workflow ProcessInstance with its business/service object (V1 and V2 /_search).

businessObject.description: The module's own business object (e.g. Property, License) as a free-form map

serviceObject.description: Related service object (e.g. FSM service/trip), as a free-form map

statusMap.description: List of single-entry maps of applicationStatus to count

Project.description: A single project-inbox result item joining the workflow ProcessInstance with the Project module object (V2 /project/_search).

project.description: The Project module's own object, as a free-form map

InboxMetricCriteria.description: Criteria for the DSS aggregate inbox metrics endpoint (/v1/dss/_search).

InboxElasticSearchCriteria.description: Search criteria for the reserved Elasticsearch-backed V1 endpoint.

IndexSearchCriteria.description: Search criteria for the generic V2 Elasticsearch query engine.

Field.description: A single projected key/value field from an indexed document.

value.description: Value of the field; type varies by field

Data.description: One matching document, reduced to its projected fields.
